# Settings reference

Every setting macOSLAPS 4.0 reads, with its built-in default. Deliver them in a configuration profile for the preference domain `com.joshua-d-miller.macoslaps` (the 3.x domain `edu.psu.macoslaps` still works through 4.x). Leave a key out to use its default.

!!! tip "Check what a Mac actually uses"
    `sudo macOSLAPS -showConfig` prints every setting, its value and where it came from (managed profile, local file or default). `FirstPass` is never printed.

The same list is in the repository as a [Jamf Pro custom schema and an iMazing Profile Editor manifest](https://github.com/joshua-d-miller/macOSLAPS/tree/4.0.0.950/Profile%20Manifests), and as an [example plist](https://github.com/joshua-d-miller/macOSLAPS/blob/4.0.0.950/PLIST%20Example/com.joshua-d-miller.macoslaps.plist).

## Account and method

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LocalAdminAccount` | string | `admin` |  | Short name of the local admin account macOSLAPS manages. |
| `Method` | string | `AD` | `Local`, `AD` | Local stores the password in the System keychain for your MDM to collect with `-escrow`. AD writes it to the computer object in Active Directory. |
| `DaysTillExpiration` | integer | `60` | 1 or more | Days between rotations. |
| `FirstPass` | string | (none) |  | The account's current password, used once for the first rotation (needed for an account with a secureToken). Never printed by `-showConfig`. |
| `RemoveKeychain` | boolean | `true` |  | Delete the admin's login keychain after a rotation, since it would still use the old password. |

## Password

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PasswordStyle` | string | `random` | `random`, `readable`, `passphrase` | random, or readable (letters and digits without look-alikes, grouped by 4, for reading over the phone). passphrase falls back to readable for now. |
| `PasswordLength` | integer | `12` | 1 or more | Generated characters. Separators are extra. |
| `PasswordGrouping` | integer | `0` | 0 or more | Insert a separator every N characters (0: none). |
| `PasswordSeparator` | string | `-` |  | Character between groups. |
| `RemovePassChars` | string | `'` |  | Characters never used in a password. |
| `ExclusionSets` | array of string | (empty) | any of `symbols`, `letters`, `numbers` | Whole sets never used in a password. |
| `PasswordRequirements` | dictionary | `Lowercase` 0, `Uppercase` 0, `Number` 0, `Symbol` 0 |  | Every password has at least this many of each kind. |

## Escrow and inventory

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EscrowCertificates` | array of string | (empty) |  | RSA certificates (PEM text or base64 DER, one per item). `-escrow` encrypts its output to them with CMS (AES-256). If set but none is usable, `-escrow` prints no password. |
| `StagedRotation` | string | `auto` | `auto`, `on`, `off` | auto: stage the next password when `-escrow` ran on this Mac in the last 14 days. on: always. off: rotate immediately. |
| `EscrowConfirmations` | integer | `2` | 1 or more | `-escrow` exports needed before a staged password is applied. |
| `InventoryHook` | string | (empty) | (empty), `jamf`, `custom` | jamf runs jamf recon after a rotation; custom runs InventoryHookCommand. |
| `InventoryHookCommand` | array of string | (empty) |  | The program and its arguments, one per item. |
| `InventoryHookConfirms` | boolean | `false` |  | True if the custom command collects inventory, so it confirms a staged password. |

## Device mode

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RetrievalMode` | string | `escrow` | `escrow`, `device` | escrow: the MDM collects the password (`-escrow`). device: the MDM collects a reveal code and the password is revealed on the Mac. |
| `RevealGracePeriod` | integer | `4` | 0–24 | Device mode: hours the revealed password keeps working before it rotates (0: no rotation after a reveal). |
| `RevealAction` | string | `rotateAndLogout` | `rotateAndLogout`, `rotate` | rotateAndLogout logs the admin out first if it has a session; rotate only rotates. |
| `ADRevealCode` | boolean | `false` |  | Device mode with Method AD: store the reveal code in Active Directory instead of the password. |

## Admin group protection

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ApprovedAdmins` | array of string | (empty) |  | Accounts allowed to stay in the admin group besides the managed admin and root: short names, or group:<name> for a group's members. |
| `AdminGroupPolicy` | string | `auto` | `auto`, `report`, `enforce` | auto: remove unapproved admins unless an elevation tool is installed (then report only). report: only list them. enforce: remove them even with an elevation tool. |
| `AllowMDMManagedAccount` | boolean | `true` |  | If LocalAdminAccount was created by your MDM during Automated Device Enrollment (PreStage admin, Intune ADE admin, Auto Admin), true manages it with a warning (the MDM can change its password too); false refuses. |

## Active Directory

| Key | Type | Default | Values | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ADSchema` | string | `legacy` | `legacy`, `windowsLAPS`, `both` | legacy: ms-Mcs-AdmPwd. windowsLAPS: msLAPS-Password (ADUC LAPS tab, Get-LapsADPassword). both: write both. windowsLAPS and both are experimental. |
| `PreferredDC` | string | (empty) |  | Domain controller to use with Method AD. |
